newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Pawn shareholders seek board changes.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Pawn shareholders seek board changes.

text.p: A group of shareholders of U.S. Pawn said Monday that it is asking for a special shareholders meeting, September 12, to unseat six directors of U.S. Pawn Inc, including its chief executive Melvin Wedgle.

The group, which said it represents more than 10 percent of the company's outstanding shares, said it would formally declare its intentions in a 13-D statement to be filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission on August 21.
It said it is dissatisified with the company's stock performance and management has failed to maximize shareholder value.

Wedgle told Reuters that he was unaware of the demand for a special meeting. He added that he believed some of the company's market-makers were attempting to take over the company and that steps had been taken to turn around its stock price.
U.S. Pawn closed Monday at 2-1/8, down 3/16.
